answers.core: This reduces confusion when people use default methods like `look_at` and copy code from official tutorials, while using the vast majority of available 3D assets.
answers.workaround:
One could write a custom import script that flips the root node.
But I think it is a question of having good defaults: using any model generated by 3D tools that export to GLTF will face backwards in the editor.

title: Add an option to fix the Z-forward vector when importing a GLTF file
